This is a second UCC research vacancy (listing 1952679) advertised through the university's HR portal, following the same salaried-employment model as other Irish research posts. The advertisement defines the project, the supervisor team, the contract terms and the closing date.

Programme Highlights

  • Salaried position with employee benefits rather than a stipend
  • Posting-specific requirements and closing date
  • Part of UCC's rolling research recruitment
  • Ideal route for candidates seeking employment-based doctoral training

Who Should Apply

Applicants matching the specific post's degree and research requirements as set out in the advertisement.

Funding and Costs

Salaried research position per the UCC pay scales stated in the advertisement.

Deadline and How to Apply

Read the full listing on the UCC website and submit your application through the official recruitment portal before its closing date. Key deadline information: Closing date as stated in the UCC vacancy listing — check the posting before applying.
